questions.question: What slope range does the paper give for a pit funnel, constrained by the angle of repose of dry regolith?
How thick are the discrete wall layers seen in LRO NAC images of the Mare Tranquillitatis Pit?
In the statement of science objective O2, how many pits does the paper say have been located in the mare regions?
What operational performance did the Apollo 17 Traverse Gravimeter Experiment actually achieve on the lunar surface?
Around what frequency are the thermal moonquakes that dominate the ambient lunar seismic noise?
Over what frequency band does RIMFAX operate?
What angular sharpness must the pit-wall photographic instrument achieve to pick out 5 cm details from the far rim?
Over how long is a paleo-regolith layer of about 5 cm assumed to have formed, given Marius Hills regolith formation rates?
What peak acceleration did bench testing show the tunable etalon survives?
How many electric motors does the walking machine use to point its instruments where it wants them?
Terrestrial analogues identify one failure mode, acting at stress levels below overall continuum failure, as a primary way pits form in lava tubes. What is that mode called?

The gravity forward model considers two candidate lava tubes; the wider one is given a width matching the approximate width of the rille on which the Marius Hills Pit sits. What vertical height does that wider modelled tube have?
At the first vantage point beside the pit the robot takes a compositional depth profile as well as images. What is the total mass of that profiling instrument's sensor head?

Two of the robot's survey instruments record along the standard route at spacings that differ by a factor of one hundred. The more closely spaced of the two is adapted from a device flown on a Mars rover -- what is that device's acronym?
Of the two antenna heights above the regolith used in the forward simulations, which one gives the higher energy reaching the cave?
Table 1 lists an electrical conductivity for each simulated material. What conductivity does it give for the material whose wave velocity the Kirchhoff migration assumed?
LunarLeaper tightens one instrument's sampling to every 5 m while crossing the rille. In which lava tube system was a recent Earth-analogue survey with that same geophysical method carried out?
What is the combined weight of the miniaturised infrared instrument's optical head and its driving electronics?
By how many percentage points does the plagioclase fraction fall between the base-layer mixture and the top-layer mixture?
In the migrated GPR section, by how many metres is the bottom of the cave mislocated?
